cause: Training/serving skew on f3 due to a missing transform on the serving path. The training pipeline applies a log1p transform (train_f3 = ln(1 + raw)), but the online service serves the raw untransformed value (serve_f3 = exp(train_f3) - 1 = expm1(train_f3)). Verified on the Databricks warehouse by joining the two tables on entity_id: f1, f2, f4, f5 match exactly (mean_abs_diff=0, corr=1.0), while f3 satisfies train_f3 = ln(1 + serve_f3) to floating-point precision (max abs error ~6e-7). The serving feature pipeline omits the log1p normalization that was applied during training.
